lessons.keep: Use a repeated prop and reaction structure to make a business comparison memorable.
lessons.avoid: Claiming that a bigger creator pool alone proves better campaign results.
lessons.open: Creator counts, cost and reach claims, service workflow and sound remain unverified.
try: For Tin, contrast one manually managed campaign with a clearly shown set of approved campaign outputs using the same brief.
Test a shorter reaction hold with a creator selection and brief screen inserted before the final slogan.

comparison.story: Set up status competition. → Establish the expensive single-creator approach. → Present the contrasting creator-team approach. → Name the service and its scale claim. → Visualize one versus many. → Turn the business contrast into comic defeat. → Resolve the comparison. → State the positioning and destination.
